tests: Headings with no visual weight — same size, same font, normal weight. Distinguished only by capitalisation, small-caps, italics and a little leading.
attacks: Font-size-based heading detection. The opposite failure to h01: here a size heuristic finds no headings at all and flattens a five-level document into prose.
title: Berth Allocation Procedure
intentionalProblems: headings are visually indistinguishable from body text except by case and leading
